narrative.overview: A dark, quiet surface where money figures are the brightest thing on the screen. The default is Midnight Indigo: a near-black blue canvas with slightly lighter frosted cards, one luminous violet accent, and green and rose reserved for gain and loss. The light theme mirrors it on a cool off-white; the optional OLED palette swaps violet for gold on true black. All three are intentional brand commitments and every component reads colour from the same semantic variables.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic HSL variables only; three palettes share one variable set.
Frosted, softly lit tiles on a dark canvas with a single ambient accent glow.
One accent per palette; success and danger are separate tokens.
Inter Variable with Heebo Variable fallback for Hebrew; tabular numerals in tables.
RTL is first-class: logical utilities only.
12px minimum text size; 44px touch targets on coarse pointers.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Only primary is a brand colour. Never add a second accent; use success/danger for meaning and chart-* for data series only.

rules.name: The Semantic Variable Rule
rules.body: Colour comes from a variable (bg-card, text-muted-foreground, border-border). Raw hex or hsl literals in components are not part of the system.

rules.name: The Three Palettes Rule
rules.body: Any new surface must be checked in light, Midnight Indigo and OLED gold.

rules.name: The Steady Figures Rule
rules.body: Tables and columns of figures use tabular numerals; money values are set large, semibold or bold, and tightly tracked.

rules.name: The Logical Edge Rule
rules.body: Use ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, start-, end-, text-start; not left/right.

rules.name: The Thumb Reach Rule
rules.body: Primary navigation lives at the bottom on phones; controls on coarse pointers get a hit area of at least 44px.

rules.name: The Quiet Glow Rule
rules.body: Depth is soft and low-contrast; the accent glow is reserved for the single primary action and the page wash.

dos: Do take every colour from a semantic variable so light, Midnight Indigo and gold all work.
Do use logical utilities for all horizontal spacing, position and alignment.
Do set money figures large, semibold or bold, tightly tracked, and tabular in columns; honour the blur-values setting.
Do use success and danger for direction of money, tinted at 15% for pills, and keep warnings calm.
Do keep touch targets at 44px on coarse pointers and text at 12px or larger.
Do pass chart colours through useChartTokens.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand accent or hard-coded palette values.
Don't use physical left/right/ml/mr/pl/pr on surfaces that must flip in Hebrew.
Don't add movement that is not neutralised by the reduced-motion block (entrance translate and scale variables, press scale).
Don't use card with blur on top of another blurred tile; nest with flat tints (foreground/5) instead.
